description: Defines the InstalledPackagesList class for managing and querying installed Composer packages within Drupal's package manager module.

classes.name: InstalledPackagesList
classes.description: A class extending ArrayObject to list installed Composer packages, with methods to compare packages, retrieve specific packages, and enforce immutability.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Prevents modification of the package list by throwing an exception.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Prevents modification of the package list by throwing an exception.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Prevents modification of the package list by throwing an exception.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a package by key, returning null if not found.

methods.name: exchangeArray
methods.description: Prevents modification of the package list by throwing an exception.

methods.name: getPackagesNotIn
methods.description: Returns packages present in this list but not in another.

methods.name: getPackagesWithDifferentVersionsIn
methods.description: Returns packages with different versions in another list.

methods.name: getPackageByDrupalProjectName
methods.description: Finds a package by Drupal project name, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getCorePackageList
methods.description: Provides a list of core package names considered part of Drupal core.

methods.name: getCorePackages
methods.description: Returns installed core packages, optionally including development packages.
